_doc: FACE2 (unarmed, no sword): action/key -> expression. Sprite char maps: v2/face2/out/sprite/<VIEW>_<expr>.txt (VIEW S,SE,E,NE; N = N_neutral for every key; W/SW/NW = mirrored E/SE/NE face stamps). Portraits: v2/face2/portrait/P_<expr>.txt. Grammar: v2/face2/FACE_GUIDE2.md; stamps: v2/face2/tools/kit.py. 'hold' = keep the previous frame's face.

blink.rule: insert on an idle loop boundary, never on a bob extreme; double-blink 1 in 5

variant_cheerful.use: every 3rd-4th idle loop, after a win, when an NPC talks to her

run.note: no blink during run; contact frames may use cheerful for a carefree run cycle variant

attack_throw._note: the attack is now a THROW (no sword)

surprised.use: item pickup, enemy appears, being startled; 2-3 frames then neutral

timing_rules: Face changes land ON the key pose frame (one-frame lead allowed on shout so the open mouth is there at release).
Hold shout through the release/hit-stop; return to neutral on recover, cheerful on settle so she reads confident, not exhausted.
Blink never overlaps shout/effort/pain/joy (they already change the eyes).
NE shows the expression only through the lash tip (open eyes) and the cheek blush; N never changes.
